It points to the same Section 3.1 formula (1/√β ∝ n^{-1/(p+4)}) and identifies a conflict with the convergence claim, which is part of the same adaptive bandwidth mechanism that gt_id 1 flags as logically inconsistent.
No finding addresses Equation 8 or the undefined dimensionality of the weight matrices W_φ, W_g, and W_λ. Finding 1 discusses bandwidth formulas in a different section entirely.
